t: What he said when he asked for rain
a: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبَادَكَ وَبَهِيمَتَكَ وَانْشُرْ رَحْمَتَكَ وَأَحْىِ بَلَدَكَ الْمَيِّتَ
p: Allāhumma-sqi ʿibādaka wa bahīmatak, wa-nshur raḥmatak, wa aḥyi baladaka-l-mayyit
m: O Allah, water Your servants and Your animals, spread Your mercy, and bring Your dead land back to life.
